assertions: real CLI and Web requests were both captured
every actual HTTP request carries the exact selected compiled primary policy
selected policy fits fallback system reserve without raising the budget
documented native capabilities exist in the actual request schemas
new requests carry the versioned challenger rather than legacy prompt
readonly policy does not advertise mutating/exec/plan capabilities
cli rejects invalid policy before provider or listener startup
web rejects invalid policy before provider or listener startup
actualCoding.limitation: A scripted local HTTP provider chooses the actions. Passing proves policy installation and runtime/tool invariants; it cannot prove policy obedience or a real-model quality gain.

managed.order: AB BA alternating within each kind

overlapMetric.source: correlated successful read_file evidence within known native start/exit interval; model-request time is not an action; unknown exit is not positive proof

managed.scope: causal engineering protocol probe; baseline/candidate gate coordination differs, so durations are not an identical-workload performance comparison or model-quality evidence

checkFixture.candidateGate: release only after correlated successful source-file read; remains released for repair attempt

launch.shutdownControl: test-only IPC invokes the actual production SIGTERM handler; not native OS signal delivery

fixtureOwnerPreflight.scope: Fresh fixture owner allocated before browser checks; no task input or model request; product lease policy unchanged

engine.viewportScope: Desktop Chromium responsive sizes; no physical mobile or Windows claim

browser.scope: Named daily production UI interactions only; not a claim that every visible control is implemented or verified
